patch_description: The current single staggered-grid seed can get stuck in a mediocre local optimum. Known good packings of 26 circles mix hexagonal rows with corner-filling circles and unequal radii. I add several diverse seed layouts (staggered grids with different row counts, a hexagonal lattice with boundary circles, a polar/ring arrangement) and run the existing refinement + LP radius solve on each, keeping the best arrangement. This multi-start strategy substantially raises the achievable sum of radii while staying fast (few hundred ms per seed), and the exact LP guarantees the reported radii remain valid for the chosen centers.
